How tournaments work

Register a team

  1. Create your team

    Register a team name, tag and roster. Captains can edit the roster until check-in closes.

  2. Check in

    Check in on match day from the team page. Missed check-ins forfeit the first match.

  3. Play your matches

    Lobby codes appear on your team page. Report scores with a screenshot; admins verify every result.

  4. Get paid

    Prize money is paid to the captain within 30 days of the final, after identity checks.

Nightforge
